author: Andrew Fisher

checks.name: Every unique source contract line retained once
Every source line has an explicit coverage disposition
Confirmed source duplicates are excluded from unique-line total
Evidence uses the same shared record version
Current reference count agrees with snapshot
Cancelled history excluded from active canonical count
New source requests are marked unreceived
Source requirement conflict does not invent arrivals
No native or original source mutations
Every review row has reference, quantity, current state, source, contract and action
No executable formulas in review workbook
No price totals in equipment-only workbook

scope: Read-only source coverage validation. No claim of full physical or financial accuracy.
